title: Wayland error in dialogs when switchting to second screen
body:
### Tested versions

Only noticed the error in: v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb] and 4.7.0

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 580.173.02) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The error occurs when opening a dialog menu and changing focus to another app.

[Logs](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30164552/logs.txt)

### Steps to reproduce

Edit: two monitor setup is needed to reproduce!

1. Start the Engine
2. Open any project
3. Right click on a folder and try to create a scene, click on the button with the tree icon in Root Type
4. Focus on second screen / different app, e.g. browser window (click on the other app / screen so the focus is not on the Engine)
5. Click into the selection tree and try to select any Node. It will freeze and then crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any Godot project will do.
